title: The whole machine
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from brain3d/trace.json and films/qkv_data.json.

blocks.text: Here is the whole machine, on one question. Emma asks: how many city e-bike battery packs do we have in Manchester stores?
blocks.say: Here is the whole machine, on one question. Emma asks: how many city e-bike battery packs do we have in Manchester stores?

blocks.text: First, her chat is cut into tokens. One hundred tiles, each with its own number. Manchester is a single tile.
blocks.say: First, her chat is cut into tokens. One hundred tiles, each with its own number. Manchester is a single tile.

blocks.text: Each tile looks up its vector: a column of 896 numbers, learned in training.
blocks.say: Each tile looks up its vector: a column of eight hundred and ninety-six numbers, learned in training.

blocks.text: Then attention. The last position sends out a query, and every key answers. In block 24, head 2, 65 percent of the weight lands on Manchester.
blocks.say: Then attention. The last position sends out a query, and every key answers. In block twenty-four, head two, sixty-five percent of the weight lands on Manchester.

blocks.text: Attention and a small network make one block. The column climbs all 24, in one pass, and near the top, an answer starts to form.
blocks.say: Attention and a small network make one block. The column climbs all twenty-four, in one pass, and near the top, an answer starts to form.

blocks.text: At the top, it is scored against all 151,936 tokens. Softmax turns the scores into probabilities. We: 56 percent. As: 8. Manchester: 6.
blocks.say: At the top, it is scored against all one hundred and fifty-one thousand, nine hundred and thirty-six tokens. Softmax turns the scores into probabilities. We: fifty-six percent. As: eight. Manchester: six.

blocks.text: One token is chosen. It joins the strip, and the whole pass runs again. One token at a time.
blocks.say: One token is chosen. It joins the strip, and the whole pass runs again. One token at a time.

blocks.text: Then the number. One, at 34 percent. Zero. Zero. A confident 100. Ledgerline says 5,400.
blocks.say: Then the number. One, at thirty-four percent. Zero. Zero. A confident one hundred. Ledgerline says five thousand four hundred.

blocks.text: Nothing in the prompt carried the stock, so the model made a number up. Put the stock line into the prompt, and the same model answers 5,400. That is where we go next.
blocks.say: Nothing in the prompt carried the stock, so the model made a number up. Put the stock line into the prompt, and the same model answers five thousand four hundred. That is where we go next.
